items.title: Pay outstanding balance (2nd reminder)
items.quote: Wir bitten Sie dringend, den Gesamtbetrag bis Freitag, 11.12.2026 zu begleichen.
items.computation: The letter states a fixed calendar date for payment: 'bis Freitag, 11.12.2026'. Verified 11.12.2026 falls on a Friday (no weekend/holiday shift needed). This is a company (not an authority) letter, so no deemed-delivery rule applies; the printed date is taken as the due date as written.

warnings: This is the second reminder (2. Mahnung); an earlier reminder dated 04.11.2026 is referenced but was not provided, so the full payment history cannot be verified.

The letter threatens to pass the debt to a collection agency (Inkassounternehmen) with added costs if payment is not received by the deadline — a common but legitimate dunning tactic; still, verify the underlying order (BW-26-30871) and delivery (15.10.2026) match your own records before paying.

The IBAN (DE67 3705 0198 0005 5770 00) is well-formed and matches the sender's own letterhead, but a valid IBAN does not prove ownership — confirm via the recipient-name check your bank performs, or against a previous invoice, before transferring.
